metadata.question: On August 3, 2025, were there more than 120 fires active in Saskatchewan, Canada?

<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Saskatchewan, Canada from FAO GAUL 2015 Level 1.
- Date: 2025-08-03 UTC (one-day window).
- Collections: Try FIRMS active fire point datasets in a robust order (VIIRS archive first, then MODIS; avoid NRT unless necessary). For each candidate, also check global same-day count to exclude datasets that don’t have data for that date (e.g., NRT outside window).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Not applicable for point detections. We report detection counts per dataset.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If no dataset evaluates at all → D.
- If no dataset has any global detections that day → C1 (dataset/date coverage failure).
- If datasets have global detections but 0 in Saskatchewan → B (valid zero).
- If count result is null/NaN → C3.
- Else compare max dataset count to 120 for A/B.

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = ee.Date('2025-08-03');
    const end = start.advance(1, 'day');
    const gaul = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level1');
    const saskFC = gaul.filter(ee.Filter.and(
      ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Canada'),
      ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Saskatchewan')
    ));
    const saskCount = await saskFC.size().getInfo();
    if (saskCount === 0 || saskCount === null) {
      console.log('Region lookup failed: Saskatchewan not found in GAUL.');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }
    const saskGeom = saskFC.geometry();
    const saskAreaKm2 = await ee.Number(saskGeom.area(1)).divide(1e6).getInfo();
    console.log(`Region: Saskatchewan (features: ${saskCount}, area: ${Math.round(saskAreaKm2)} km²)`);
    console.log(`Date (UTC): 2025-08-03`);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    // Candidate FIRMS datasets (prefer archive, avoid relying solely on NRT)
    const candidates = [
      { id: 'FIRMS/VIIRS/V1/VNP14IMGTDL', label: 'VIIRS 375m (V1)' },
      { id: 'FIRMS/VIIRS/C2/VNP14IMGTDL', label: 'VIIRS 375m (C2)' },
      { id: 'FIRMS/MODIS/C6/MCD14DL', label: 'MODIS 1km (C6)' },
      { id: 'FIRMS/MODIS/C61/MCD14DL', label: 'MODIS 1km (C61)' },
      { id: 'FIRMS/VIIRS/V1/VNP14IMGTDL_NRT', label: 'VIIRS 375m NRT (V1)' },
      { id: 'FIRMS/VIIRS/C2/VNP14IMGTDL_NRT', label: 'VIIRS 375m NRT (C2)' },
    ];

    const results = [];
    for (const cand of candidates) {
      try {
        const fc = ee.FeatureCollection(cand.id);
        const dayGlobal = fc.filterDate(start, end);
        const dayRegion = dayGlobal.filterBounds(saskGeom);

        // Evaluate: global count for date (to detect datasets with no coverage that day),
        // and regional count.
        const [gCount, rCount] = await Promise.all([
          dayGlobal.size().getInfo(),
          dayRegion.size().getInfo()
        ]);

        if (typeof gCount !== 'number' || typeof rCount !== 'number' ||
            !isFinite(gCount) || !isFinite(rCount)) {
          // Calculation failure for this dataset; skip but record.
          results.push({ id: cand.id, label: cand.label, ok: false, err: 'NaN' });
          continue;
        }

        results.push({
          id: cand.id, label: cand.label,
          ok: true,
          globalCount: gCount,
          regionCount: rCount
        });
      } catch (e) {
        // Dataset load/eval error; record and continue.
        results.push({ id: cand.id, label: cand.label, ok: false, err: 'load/eval error' });
      }
    }

    const okResults = results.filter(r => r.ok === true);
    if (okResults.length === 0) {
      console.log('Datasets checked: 0 usable (all failed to load/evaluate).');
      console.log('D');
      return;
    }

    // Keep only datasets that have at least one global detection that day.
    const validForDate = okResults.filter(r => (r.globalCount || 0) > 0);
    if (validForDate.length === 0) {
      // No dataset had any detections globally that day; implies date not covered by all tried datasets.
      console.log('No global detections in any candidate dataset on this date (likely no coverage).');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise per-dataset stats and compute decision using max regional count.
    let maxDetections = 0;
    for (const r of validForDate) {
      console.log(`${r.label}: region detections=${r.regionCount}, global detections=${r.globalCount}`);
      if (r.regionCount > maxDetections) maxDetections = r.regionCount;
    }

    // 3. Validation & Final Answer
    // If the metric is not a number, it's a calculation failure.
    if (!isFinite(maxDetections)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Max detections among datasets: ${maxDetections}`);

    if (maxDetections > 120) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Catch-all for unexpected errors (e.g., memory/syntax)
    console.log('Unexpected error:', e && e.message ? e.message : e);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
